summary_1line: Rama and his allies survey Lanka’s defenses as Vibhishana reports enemy deployments, after which Rama assigns commanders and battle positions for the coming assault.

image_candidates.scene_text: Rama stands before the gathered monkey and bear chiefs overlooking the distant golden city of Lanka as Vibhishana describes its guarded gates.
Four spies disguised as birds circle above the fortified walls of Lanka, peering down at armies and war elephants stationed at the gates.
Rama decisively points toward the northern gate while the monkey generals gather around, receiving their battle assignments before the assault.
